scripts.build: yarn workspace @planning-espoir/shared build && yarn workspace @planning-espoir/api build && yarn workspace @planning-espoir/webapp build
scripts.dev: yarn workspace @planning-espoir/shared build && concurrently -k "yarn workspace @planning-espoir/api start:dev" "yarn workspace @planning-espoir/webapp dev"
scripts.test: yarn workspace @planning-espoir/shared build && yarn workspace @planning-espoir/api test && yarn workspace @planning-espoir/webapp test
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @planning-espoir/api lint && yarn workspace @planning-espoir/webapp lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @planning-espoir/shared build && yarn workspace @planning-espoir/api typecheck && yarn workspace @planning-espoir/webapp typecheck
